answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ocean only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, whisper is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any grove approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
